book_title: Moon New York City Walks: See the City Like a Local (2nd edition)
author: Moon Travel Guides
source_file: Moon New York City Walks- See the City Like a Local (Travel -- Moon Travel Guides -- Travel Guide Ser, 2nd ed, New York, 2020 -- Avalon Publishing -- isbn13 9781640497887 -- d65d6fbdab870c8aabb9e26b894d1d97 -- Anna’s Archive.pdf
extraction_note: Self-guided walking-tour guide. Chunked at the natural per-walk level: the 6 themed walks (each = neighborhood history + numbered POI list + route directions + SIGHTS & ATTRACTIONS / FOOD & DRINK / SHOPPING descriptions with addresses+transit), plus the WITH MORE TIME section of standalone landmarks (UN, Brooklyn Museum, Met Cloisters, Prospect Park, etc.). Excluded as non-tour-landmark: front-matter intro + local-author bios, TOP 10 lists (restaurants/coffee/nightlife/arts), PRACTICAL INFORMATION, TRANSPORTATION, BIKING, NIGHTLIFE, HOTELS, and the INDEX.

chunks.section_title: Walk 1: Dumbo, Wall Street, Chinatown & Lower East Side
chunks.summary: 6.8 mi/11 km walk: Brooklyn Bridge Park, Staten Island Ferry, Castle Clinton, Wall Street, City Hall, Chinatown/Columbus Park, and Lower East Side galleries & Tenement Museum.

chunks.section_title: Walk 2: Nolita, SoHo, West Village & High Line
chunks.summary: 7.8 mi/12.5 km walk through Nolita, SoHo cast-iron district, West Village, and the High Line.
Walk through Midtown: Times Square, Bryant Park, the theater district, and Union Square.

chunks.section_title: Walk 4: Upper East Side & Central Park
chunks.summary: 6.3 mi/10 km walk: Museum Mile (Met, Guggenheim), the Upper East Side, and Central Park.
10 mi/16 km walk: Lincoln Center, Upper West Side, Cathedral of St. John the Divine, and Harlem.
5.3 mi/8.5 km walk through Williamsburg, Brooklyn: waterfront, galleries, shops, and food spots.

chunks.section_title: With More Time: Additional NYC Sights
chunks.summary: Standalone landmarks beyond the walks: United Nations, Brooklyn Museum, Met Cloisters, Wyckoff House, Prospect Park, Hudson River Park, and more.
